description: OKX public REST market data for USDT-margined perpetual swaps (BTC-USDT-SWAP, ETH-USDT-SWAP, SOL-USDT-SWAP): daily candlesticks (/market/history-candles, bar 1D) and instrument specifications (/public/instruments)
permission_basis: Public market data served without authentication by OKX public REST endpoints (/market/history-candles, /public/instruments), used for research only; raw payloads are not redistributed. OKX Terms of Service reviewed 2026-11-18. This registry entry is an explicit research-use assertion, not a legal determination.
timestamp_basis: Exchange event time: a 1D candle's ts is its open time (16:00 UTC, i.e. midnight UTC+8); the bar's values are knowable at its close (open + 24h). Only confirmed bars are used.
